Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
B) A' का use होता है जब हम किसी चीज को specify नहीं करते हैं और वह noun consonant sound से शुरू होता है। 'Muskmelon' यहाँ generic sense में use किया गया है, इसलिए 'a muskmelon' सही है। बाकी विकल्प 'few' और 'much' इस context में fit नहीं होते हैं।
'a'is used when we are not specifying something in particular and the noun starts with a consonant sound. Here, 'muskmelon' is used in a generic sense, so 'a muskmelon' is correct. The other options 'few' and 'much' don't fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.
Satyajit Ray's films are rich in sociological elements which portray themes like faulty social structures, childhood experiences, poverty-stricken India, rural life, complexities in relationships and politics, religion, gender and on. Films like Devi or The Goddess and Mahapurush or The Godman show how religion becomes a breeding ground of superstitions and how the blind faith of people in ‘Godmen’, without analysing the reality, leave people trapped in the end. In Pather Panchali or Song of the Road, Ray shows how Apu and Durga enjoy their childhood despite their poverty. The innocence and mirth of childhood offers a sharp contrast with the disconsolate faces of other adults in the family who are affected by the present harsh situations. A critique of autocracy is found in his film Hirak Rajar Deshe or In the Country of the Diamond King which is an overall political satire. Although Satyajit Ray's films are deeply rooted in Bengali culture, they have a universal significance, and much of it is perhaps because his film making is heavily inspired by neo-realist principles
Which of the following is NOT a theme of any of Satyajit Ray’s movies, according to the passage?
questions.solution: A) Motivational life stories'का use होगा क्योंकि passage में इस theme का कहीं जिक्र नहीं है। Passage में Satyajit Ray की फिल्मों के themes जैसे कि faulty social structures, childhood experiences, गरीबी, ग्रामीण जीवन, रिश्तों और राजनीति, धर्म, लिंग आदि की चर्चा है, लेकिन motivational life stories का जिक्र नहीं है। इसलिए, option A सही है। जबकि बाकी options B, C, और D उस passage में उल्लेखित themes से मेल करते हैं।

Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.
Satyajit Ray's films are rich in sociological elements which portray themes like faulty social structures, childhood experiences, poverty-stricken India, rural life, complexities in relationships and politics, religion, gender and on. Films like Devi or The Goddess and Mahapurush or The Godman show how religion becomes a breeding ground of superstitions and how the blind faith of people in ‘Godmen’, without analysing the reality, leave people trapped in the end. In Pather Panchali or Song of the Road, Ray shows how Apu and Durga enjoy their childhood despite their poverty. The innocence and mirth of childhood offers a sharp contrast with the disconsolate faces of other adults in the family who are affected by the present harsh situations. A critique of autocracy is found in his film Hirak Rajar Deshe or In the Country of the Diamond King which is an overall political satire. Although Satyajit Ray's films are deeply rooted in Bengali culture, they have a universal significance, and much of it is perhaps because his film making is heavily inspired by neo-realist principles
 Which film by Satyajit Ray deals with the portrayal of childhood?
questions.solution: A) Pather Panchali'का use होगा क्योंकि passage में स्पष्ट रूप से बताया गया है कि Ray ने 'Pather Panchali' में Apu और Durga की गरीबी के बावजूद बचपन की खुशी को दर्शाया है। जबकि बाकी फिल्मों में इस तरह की थीम नहीं है।
